author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads Firewall IP Filter lines from DrayOS Vigor routers, sent over syslog to the data collector. Each line goes to Netflow with the action, rule and direction.
notes:
Setup:
- For DrayOS Vigor routers (not the Linux-based Vigor2960 and Vigor3900).
- Turn on syslog to the data collector with the Firewall Log, and tick Syslog on the filter rules to log.

Field mapping:
- Firewall IP Filter lines go to Netflow, with the action, rule and direction.

Time:
- The router's BSD syslog time has no year or zone and is read as UTC.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the format DrayTek's firewall syslog guide describes.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13.

Known gaps:
- CSM, VPN, user access and other lines are left to the parsers already in the tenant.
- DrayTek doesn't publish the text of its VPN or login messages, so they aren't covered.
